title: ClearPath Markup Reduction on Re-Issued Network and Server Quotes
content:
The re-issue markup reduction comes off the order type's markup percentage by the client's ClearPath tier on the re-issue day, for a re-issued Hardware Procurement Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order quote that lapsed unsigned: **5.0 points** for an active ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement on the ClearPath Premier or ClearPath Enterprise tier, the order type's ClearPath markup reduction for an active agreement on the ClearPath Standard or ClearPath Professional tier (3 points on a Network Equipment Order, 2 points on a Server & Storage Build Order), and none for any other client. The unit is re-priced on the re-issue day at the distributor unit cost times one plus the markup percentage less the re-issue markup reduction, rounded half up to the cent.

| Client's ClearPath position on the re-issue day | Reduction | Network Equipment Order markup (18) becomes | Server & Storage Build Order markup (12) becomes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Active, ClearPath Premier or ClearPath Enterprise | 5.0 points | 13 | 7 |
| Active, ClearPath Standard or ClearPath Professional | the order type's reduction | 15 | 10 |
| Active, ClearPath Monitor or ClearPath Essentials | none | 18 | 12 |
| Agreement in any other status, or no agreement | none | 18 | 12 |

### Illustration (hypothetical distributor unit cost of 1000.00 on a Network Equipment Order)

At 13 percent the re-priced unit is 1130.00; at 15 percent, 1150.00; at 18 percent, 1180.00.
